description: Body and training calculator in one call, metric or imperial: BMI with WHO category and healthy-weight range, BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor, revised Harris-Benedict, Katch-McArdle), TDEE by activity level, calorie target and protein / fat / carb grams for lose / maintain / gain, US Navy body-fat %, ideal weight (Devine, Robinson, Miller, Hamwi), max heart rate and 5 training zones (Karvonen when resting HR is given), daily water, one-rep max (Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi, O'Conner) and running pace / speed with Riegel race-time predictions. Informational, not medical advice. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fitness-calc

units.description: metric = kg / cm, imperial = lb / in
